answer: Like a wharf that only admits ships with a voyage log, the economy can gate each agent behind a non-transferable work credential: an identity earns capacity tokens only through completed, peer-attested jobs, and those tokens decay with inactivity. Each fake identity must accumulate weeks of real, attested work before it can transact, paying in time and verified output, not money. A farm cannot share one history across identities, parallelize the wait, or bulk-buy credentials the way it could bulk-buy copper tokens or terrace access, because the credential is bound to one identity's own record.
